verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban provides a web-based task board to run many agents in parallel with per-card isolated git worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains, plus CLI scheduling for cron-based agents that persist across sessions — directly matching unified multi-session management for a lead. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Kanban board at scale and any reporting/rollup view across sessions beyond vendor docs.
